riskNotes.title: Supply is concentrated in a few wallets
riskNotes.detail: The ten largest private wallets hold 53% of supply, excluding any trading pool. Widely held tokens are usually under 25%. A group this size can move the price on its own.

riskNotes.title: One wallet holds a large share
riskNotes.detail: The largest single wallet holds 32.5% of supply. A sale from one address that size would be felt by everyone else.

riskNotes.title: Very little of the supply is tradeable
riskNotes.detail: Only 2.2% of supply sits in a trading pool. Thin liquidity means even modest trades move the price sharply, and large positions can be hard to exit.
